annotations.title: Get the research page of an issuer

description: The page is the record's research on the issuer — no analyst, no rating, no view. get_research is Data Research: one research page per listed company on the record, written from the signed record — identity and listing, the disclosure read (filings in the trailing twelve months, cadence, latency against the issuer's exchange and sector), auditor, events and halts, orderability, coverage, open research, licensed (none loaded), as-of depth and sources — with its as-of date and its receipt. Input: ticker with exchange, or ISIN, or LEI. Output: the page (sections and Markdown), its numbers with the source page and read date of every value, its as-of date, the signature and the RCO receipt. Typed errors: unknown_issuer, ambiguous, no_page, invalid_request. Page: https://getresearch.ai/

exchange.description: Exchange for the ticker (NASDAQ, NYSE, LSE, TSX, …).

ticker.description: Ticker (AAPL), with exchange in the exchange argument or as NASDAQ:AAPL.
